name: Lava Hop!
author: Cannon Tuttle
description: A vertical platformer: hop from platform to platform and keep climbing to stay clear of the lava below.

descriptions.en: A vertical platformer: hop from platform to platform and keep climbing to stay clear of the lava below.
descriptions.it: Un platform verticale: salta da una piattaforma all'altra e continua a salire per stare lontano dalla lava.
